candidates.title: Scanty rainfall, financial crisis cause distress among Adilabad farmers
candidates.excerpt: Scanty rainfall and financial challenges have deepened distress among farmers in Adilabad, with three deaths by suicide reported within 48 hours. The district recorded a 34 per cent rainfall deficit, while farmer organisations sought government support amid crop failures and mounting debts.

candidates.title: Who is Navi Pillay? India-origin lawyer wins Nobel Peace Prize 2026 — Know all about her career and key achievements
candidates.excerpt: Nobel Peace Prize 2026: Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay won this year's Nobel Peace Prize.
